name: Vicious Spring Attack (Combat)
body:
You know how to deftly move up to your foes and still strike with great power.

Prerequisite: Dex 13, Dodge, Mobility, Spring Attack, Vital Strike, base attack bonus +6

Benefit: You may use Vital Strike, Improved Vital Strike, or Greater Vital Strike whenever you make a spring attack.
